name: Arturo Umberto Illia
contribution: President of Argentina from 1963 until his overthrow in 1966.
legacy: During his government, the national industry was promoted, 23% of the national budget was allocated to education, unemployment fell, the external debt decreased, a literacy plan was carried out and sanctioned the Minimum, Vital and Mobile Salary law and the Medications Laws.
image_credit: Government House of Argentina · Public domain
photo_credit: Government House of Argentina · Public domain

checks.lead: Arturo Umberto Illia (Spanish pronunciation: [aɾˈtuɾo wmˈbeɾto ilˈia]; 4 August 1900 – 18 January 1983) was President of Argentina from 1963 until his overthrow in 1966. He was part of the Radical Civic Union, and the People's Radical Civic Union during his presidency.
